title: Brick Blaster
description:
Brick Blaster is a traditional brick breaking game. Featuring 100 levels to complete. There are power-ups to grab, new paddles to unlock, and bosses to defeat. Plus an Endless game mode is available, allowing for unlimited game play!Features• 100 levels across 5 Challenge sections to play through.
• Bosses to defeat at the end of each Challenge section.
• Power Ups and Power Downs to catch.
• An Endless game mode offering unlimited play.
description_short: Brick Blaster is a classic brick breaking game with 100 levels to complete, power-ups to grab, and bosses to defeat!
